note: A required field left out or null is refused, an optional one is not, an undeclared name is refused, and a required list left out reads as empty, at the aggregate, one level down, two levels down, three levels down and in list members. A command argument left out is refused by the argument gate; it has no stored form, so the mint audit leaves it to dispatch. The same values are held to the mint audit's answers by spec/rust_host_reference_validate_conformance_spec.rb. The optional slots a value leaves out are echoed absent by Ruby and as null by a Rust record, so this fixture is compared with the null-valued keys dropped from both sides, and nothing else is loosened.
